notes.content:
[b]First patch is here![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34982543/3dba730d755cb8d3a1df72bf947727776b7271b4.png[/img]

What was changed?

[list]
[*]  Fairies in the Forest now don't chase the character for the whole eternity - now it's possible to run away from them - thanks for this idea to steam user Miles Hikari.

[*] Now it's possible to zoom the map - thanks for this idea to Adze who made a wonderful review of the game on YouTube.

[*] Fixed stucking in some inclined surfaces in the Forest and School area - thanks to users Cpt.ButtHurt.

[*] Fixed a situation when player was able to stuck after picking up the Noradrenaline - thanks to steam user Carnagik.
 
[*] Fixed possibility to "stand on" some walls - thanks to steam user happygiggi.

[*] Fixed a rare case when sellers take double cost for items - thanks to steam user suharki.

[*] "Bright Memory"'s health points were lowered - thanks to all the streamers who suffered from this boss on my eyes.

[*] In rare cases "Vampirism" didn't appear in the hidden wall - now it does appear always - thanks to steam user SHiSH.

[*] Monsters drop a little bit more balloons right now.

[*] Several really minor issues.

[/list]

But there is also a bad news in here. 
Linux players faced some troubles with playing the game so I temporarily "hide" linux support from the store page. Those who already bought the game will still receive all the updates. But before I figure out how to make Fearmonium run on all the varieties of Linux OS - I don't promise the game will work fine.
